from subject import detect_add_remove_conflicts


def test_no_conflicts_case_insensitive():
    add_values = ["Apple", "Banana"]
    remove_values = ["Cherry", "Date"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field")
    assert result == []


def test_conflicts_case_insensitive():
    add_values = ["Apple", "banana", "Cherry"]
    remove_values = ["apple", "BANANA", "date"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field")
    assert result == ["apple", "banana"]


def test_no_conflicts_case_sensitive():
    add_values = ["Apple", "apple"]
    remove_values = ["APPLE", "apple"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field", case_sensitive=True)
    assert result == ["apple"]


def test_conflicts_case_sensitive():
    add_values = ["Apple", "Banana"]
    remove_values = ["apple", "banana"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field", case_sensitive=True)
    assert result == []


def test_add_values_none():
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(None, ["a", "b"], "field")
    assert result == []


def test_remove_values_none():
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(["a", "b"], None, "field")
    assert result == []


def test_both_none():
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(None, None, "field")
    assert result == []


def test_empty_lists():
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts([], [], "field")
    assert result == []


def test_empty_lists_case_sensitive():
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts([], [], "field", case_sensitive=True)
    assert result == []


def test_duplicates_in_add():
    add_values = ["Apple", "apple", "APPLE"]
    remove_values = ["apple"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field")
    assert result == ["apple"]


def test_duplicates_in_remove():
    add_values = ["apple"]
    remove_values = ["Apple", "apple", "APPLE"]
    result = detect_add_remove_conflicts(add_values, remove_values, "field")
    assert result == ["apple"]


def test_sorted_output():
